author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ನಂಬದಿರು ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಜೀವನದಿ
ಜತೆಗಿರುವ ಜನನಿನ್ನ ತುಳಿದು ನಡೆಯುವರು
ಜತನದಲಿ ಪರಿಕಿಸುತ ಅನುಬಂಧ ಬೆಸೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಜಿತಬದುಕು ನಿನದಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t trust anyone too much in life;
even those beside you may trample you as they go;
if you build relationships carefully, testing as you go,
a victorious life will be yours, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Blind trust can be exploited even by those close to us. Build relationships with care and discernment, and life goes well.
